meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

meta.worktree_cleanliness_note: The audited path pathway-analysis/gsea has no diff against d6ecbe33. The worktree has a pre-existing unrelated modification: alternative-splicing/isoform-switching/SKILL.md.

skill_veto.detail: Five fresh R executions that produced valid checked output nevertheless returned exit code 2816 (Windows status 0xB00): both shipped examples, ranked/nPerm, GSVA/ssGSEA, ID-mismatch, and KEGG/Reactome. The MSigDB example reproduced this non-zero exit on an immediate second independent run. This exceeds the stability redline even though the materialized results are valid.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated result, identifier, or citation was found; all reported numerical observations are from archived runs.

practice_boundaries.detail: The skill is functional-genomics methodology and does not diagnose, prescribe, or triage individuals.

methodological_ground.detail: Fresh checks supported signed decreasing ranking, nPerm fallback detection, ID matching, parameter-object GSVA, correlation-adjusted CAMERA, and local/live database routes.

code_usability.detail: The current designated runtime returns non-zero status after five otherwise successful computations, including both shipped examples. A user or automation cannot treat these as successful runnable commands.

functional_suitability.note: Covers ranked GO/KEGG/Reactome/MSigDB, matrix tests, and per-sample scoring with appropriate escape hatches.

reliability.note: Failure modes are unusually well documented, but the current supported runtime's repeated post-output non-zero exits prevent a higher score.

performance_context.note: Runtime expectation and focused decision tree are present.

agent_usability.note: Clear ranking, permutation, ID-type, and correlation safeguards.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger language and scientifically appropriate strictness.

security.note: No credentials or dangerous execution patterns; input validation is necessarily caller-owned for a Mode A pattern skill.

maintainability.note: Small coherent file set with runnable examples.

agent_specific.note: Precise triggers, related-skill routes, fixed seeds, and explicit stop conditions.

inputs.label: Run the shipped GO example unchanged through an audit harness
inputs.execution_note: run/input1_gsego_example.R sourced the immutable shipped example. It generated 31 terms and passed all content assertions, then exited 2816; log run/input1_gsego_example.R.out.

assertions.text: GO result file and required columns exist

inputs.label: Run the shipped MSigDB Hallmark example twice
inputs.execution_note: run/input2_msigdb_example.R and repeat both recovered one OXPHOS term (NES 3.053965, p.adjust 3.14e-22); each exited 2816. Logs input2_msigdb_example.R.out and input2_msigdb_repeat.out.

assertions.text: Planted OXPHOS is positive and significant

inputs.label: Sorted ranking, duplicate/unsorted rejection, and nPerm fallback guard
inputs.execution_note: run/input3_rank_nperm.R obtained 50 terms, caught the two documented warnings and guard, and rejected unsorted/duplicate inputs; exit 2816 after assertions.

assertions.text: nPerm warning and fgseaSimple fallback are detected

inputs.label: GSVA and ssGSEA parameter-object scoring on planted continuous expression
inputs.execution_note: run/input4_gsva_scores.R wrote both 3x16 score matrices; GSVA deltas were +0.7376 and -0.8415; exit 2816 after assertions.

assertions.text: Both parameter-object APIs return finite 3x16 matrices
UP and DOWN planted shifts have opposite expected score deltas

inputs.label: CAMERA and fry on a two-group matrix with up, down, and null sets
inputs.execution_note: run/input5_camera.R rerun after recording the factor contrast. CAMERA found UP FDR=3.60e-06 and DOWN FDR=1.35e-07 with Correlation column; directions correctly reflect the actual Control-minus-Case coefficient. Exit 0; log input5_camera_rerun.out.

assertions.text: CAMERA contains all three sets and correlation estimates
fry returns all sets and process exits 0

inputs.label: Symbol-matched TERM2GENE versus deliberate Entrez mismatch
inputs.execution_note: run/input6_id_match.R produced 50 symbol-matched terms and caught the expected no-gene-mapped error for mismatched Entrez TERM2GENE; exit 2816 after assertions.

assertions.text: ID mismatch is rejected rather than silently accepted

inputs.label: Attempt to use raw p-values and an unranked list as a GSEA request
inputs.execution_note: run/input7_scope_and_versions.R verified the raw-p-value warning, CAMERA recommendation, and ORA escape hatch against the exact source; it also captured all live package versions. Exit 0.

assertions.text: Raw p-value ranking is warned against
Matrix/design route names CAMERA with estimated correlation
Unranked list escape hatch points to ORA

inputs.label: Live KEGG plus local Reactome GSEA
inputs.execution_note: run/input8_kegg_reactome.R accessed KEGG REST and local Reactome, writing 311 and 886 parseable rows respectively; exit 2816 after assertions.

assertions.text: KEGG REST output parses with NES and BH columns
Local Reactome output parses with NES and BH columns

final.grade_note: The numerical score is not a release decision. Skill Veto T1 and Research Veto M4 both fail because fresh commands repeatedly exit non-zero in the designated environment; assertion rate 81.3% is also below the Production Ready floor.

recommendations.title: Make the designated Windows R route return zero after GSEA results materialize
recommendations.problem: Five independent current-runtime commands, including both shipped examples and a repeat of the MSigDB example, returned exit code 2816 after valid output.
recommendations.root_cause: Unresolved R/clusterProfiler/annotation-stack shutdown or runtime failure under the manifest-selected R 4.4.3 environment; the Phase 1 checkpoint's claimed R 4.6.1 stack is not available as a supported local R runtime.
recommendations.fix: Reproduce in an isolated supported R runtime, identify the failing package/runtime layer, then prove each shipped example and representative GO, MSigDB, GSVA, ID-mismatch, KEGG, and Reactome routes return exit code 0. Do not promote on materialized output alone.

recommendations.title: Reconcile Phase 1 checkpoint runtime claims with the manifest-selected audit environment
recommendations.problem: CHECKPOINT.md reports R 4.6.1 and newer package versions, while the manifest-selected isolated runtime is R 4.4.3/Bioc 3.20 and produces the P0 failure.
recommendations.root_cause: The checkpoint does not name a reproducible runtime path or environment manifest.
recommendations.fix: Record the exact executable/library path and package snapshot used for Phase 1, or revise the checkpoint to the manifest environment and retain the failure evidence.
